title: vitis labrusca var. thunbergii
intro: Vitis labrusca var. thunbergii, commonly known as the fox grape or Japanese grape, is a species of grapevine native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Vitis labrusca var. thunbergii include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
